intervals.label: R&D: thin multilayer NaI(Tl) detectors and radiopure crystals; first low-background measurement at Oto Cosmo Observatory (from September 2007)
intervals.note: Year of the first PICO-LON paper (November 2006); the project start is not dated more precisely. The first underground measurement was at the Oto Cosmo Observatory from September 2007 (arXiv:0711.3053); from 2015 the measurements are at Kamioka. The end of this phase is the start of the Kamioka measurement.
intervals.quote: The WIMPs search project PICO-LON has been started with multilayer thin NaI(Tl) crystals.

intervals.label: low-background measurements in the KamLAND area of the Kamioka underground laboratory
intervals.note: Small-crystal measurements (7 d x 1.2 kg in 2015; 156.0 d x 1.34 kg in 2021-2022) are the only data so far; the 250 kg experiment is planned, not built (arXiv:2607.24448). The experiment is recorded as active because measurements were still being made in 2021-2024 (arXiv:2402.08786) and a 2025 paper reports them; no source gives a stop date.
intervals.quote: The low background measurement was started in the summer of 2015 in Kamioka underground laboratory

placements.note: The KamLAND area of the Kamioka mine; the 2016 paper gives the laboratory at 36 deg 25' N, 137 deg 18' E (the Atlas KamLAND site record carries its own campus-grade point, taken from a KamLAND thesis, not edited here).
placements.quote: The low background measurement was started in the summer of 2015 in Kamioka underground laboratory

placements.note: End inferred: the project's measurements moved to Kamioka in summer 2015 (arXiv:1512.04645); no source says when the Oto measurements stopped.
placements.quote: The low background measurement was started in September 2007 at Oto Cosmo Observatory.

depth.quote: The PICOLON experimental room is located at the KamLAND area in Kamioka Underground Laboratory at a depth of 2700 meters water equivalent (m.w.e).

target_mass.quote: The exposure time was 156.0 d×1.34 kg (realtime: 192.6 d), from 2021 Nov. 11–2022 May 24 (JST).

summary.plain: PICOLON is a Japanese search for dark matter with ultra-pure sodium iodide crystals, measured so far with a small crystal deep in the Kamioka mine. It aims to test the yearly signal reported by DAMA/LIBRA with crystals as clean as DAMA's, and plans a 250 kg detector.
summary.technical: Ultra-pure NaI(Tl) crystals made by hybrid purification (recrystallisation plus ion-exchange resins; natural K below 20 ppb, 210Pb below 5.7 uBq/kg), read by a 3-inch low-background Hamamatsu R11065-20 PMT, in a lead and copper shield in the KamLAND area of Kamioka (2700 m.w.e.). Ingot #94 (1.34 kg, ~10 photoelectrons/keV): background ~1.5 /d/kg/keV in 2-6 keVee; first six-month modulation test (2021-2022 data) finds a finite amplitude attributed to non-physical causes. A 250 kg array in the KamLAND area is planned.

technology.quote: The assembled NaI(Tl) crystal was read using a 3-inch low-background Hamamatsu R11065-20 photomultiplier tube (PMT).
technology.value: Ultra-pure NaI(Tl) crystal read by a low-background PMT in a lead and copper shield
